title: JobsRequest
description: Body of POST /api/jobs (console/api.js -> jobs.mts). Either a new job from a chat transcript (same rules as ChatRequest), or Continue of a job that ended 'paused' (docs/04 §8): the server loads the saved conversation from that job, checks job.owner === caller sub (else 404 not_found), and creates a NEW job (counts as a new job). Response: 202 {jobId}. The internal POST /api/jobs-run body {jobId, nonce} is NOT a browser contract and is not here.
